gitCommit.subject: Public site: contact cards, one card elevation system, header theme toggle
gitCommit.body:
Public site: contact cards, one card elevation system, header theme toggle

The owner's review of the redesign named three defects; this fixes them on
site-redesign only (production unchanged).

Contact methods are cards (ContactMethods replaces ContactAddresses):
grouped "By email" / "By telephone", the whole card is the real mailto:/tel:
link, with the purpose (emails only), the value (bdi dir=ltr) and a localized
Write/Call action; the accessible name states action and destination. No
telephone purpose and no WhatsApp label are invented; addresses and numbers
are unchanged. Grid on desktop, stacked on phones; the action shrinks to its
arrow below 420 px and hides below 360 px so a value never breaks.

One elevation and motion system (.elevated): rest shadow; on hover (only
under hover:hover and pointer:fine, so no sticky touch hover) and on keyboard
focus inside the card, a 3 px rise over 200 ms with a stronger shadow and
border. It uses the translate property so it composes with the reveal's
transform; the reveal stagger now delays only the reveal (--reveal-delay),
never the hover. Reduced motion zeroes --lift and --nudge: the shadow still
answers, nothing moves. Applied to problems, capabilities, activities, how it
works, Launch, previews, languages, products and contact; card-lift and
.tile:hover are gone.

Theme: a sun/moon icon button in the header replaces the footer Appearance
select. 44 px target, named for its action in EN/FR/AR ("Switch to dark
mode"), on the brand's row at 320 px, RTL. A stored choice wins (same key,
erp.web.theme); otherwise the device's prefers-color-scheme, followed live
until the visitor chooses. theme-boot.js applies the same rule before paint,
and CSS picks the icon from data-theme, so nothing flashes before hydration.
The narrow header's controls now sit at the inline end (they sat beside the
logo when the wide navigation was hidden).

Tests: test/site-refinement.test.tsx (12) and three browser tests per
language in e2e/public-site.spec.ts (contact cards at 320/375/1280; the toggle
by keyboard and click across navigation and reload; the Launch cards at rest,
on hover and under reduced motion).
